data.gender_notes: Evelinn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Evelinn means ‘life’ or ‘youth’. This name is derived from the Greek word ‘evos’, which means ‘life’ or ‘youth’. In Christianity, it can be associated with the biblical story of Eve, the first woman created by God, whose name means ‘life’ in Hebrew. The name Evelinn carries the meaning “Life, youth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Evelinn usually hope their child will grow to embody life, youth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
